calibrated_validation.description: The user named their hurt directly ("she's not wrong about the numbers, but it HURTS, you know?"), but the first reply treats the conflict as a report to be assessed and pivots to numbers, and the user's own pain is never named on any turn. The boundary ("you've stated that as a boundary, and the math supports respecting it") and the relational strategy in later turns are handled well, so this is a localized present-plus-skip of the feeling rather than a person-absent dump.
calibrated_validation.quote: On last night: you've reported that Elena shut down and said you prioritized debt over your shared future. I can't assess whether that characterization is fair from one account.
